'''New Avalon''' is a town in the [[Scarlet Enclave]] that is located just east of [[Tyr's Hand]] in the [[Eastern Plaguelands]]. The town encompasses a barracks, an orchard, an inn, a chapel, the [[New Avalon Town Hall]], and a blacksmith. [[King's Harbor]] is located to the southeast, and [[Havenshire]] is to the north.

==Trivia==
* Avalon was a sacred island in Arthurian legend where the spirits of fallen heroes were said to go, including King Arthur himself.

==Speculation==
New Avalon is presumably the same area as the Tyr's Bay attacked by the Horde during the Second War.
